card.name: Dose ranges and title words
card.fires_on: Fires on the unit or comma ending an initial-dose phrase, such as mg after a number or a comma after daily dosage. Also fires on a word inside a book or series title, like Literature, Web or of.

modes.label: Dose phrase endings
modes.description: The mg unit or a comma that closes a stated starting or daily dose in a dosing sentence.
modes.example: The effective dosage range of metoprolol tartrate tablets is 100<< mg>> per day to 450 mg

modes.label: Words in titles
modes.description: A word inside the title of a book, history or reference work, often followed by a part or publisher.

card.plain: It marks the end of a dose amount in dosing text, and also words inside the titles of books and reference works.
